Why nobody runs a Love Island league

Who: Love Island fans who'd play a fantasy league the way fantasy football fans do.

Today: Bachelor brackets (prediction games) exist, but a points league means one friend rewatching, scoring a spreadsheet and settling "that wasn't a real date!" every week.

“I watch Love Island religiously but have never seen a fantasy league for it. I play fantasy football, which is a lot of effort to prep for the draft.”

Me, the target user (my own experience, not an outside interview)

Fantasy football works because the platform does the scoring. For Love Island, the one draft app I found doesn't describe your own house rules or proof for each point.

Be upfront that the quote is my own experience as a fan; the outside-user trial is a next step.

Six agents, one code referee

gpt-6-luna proposes · plain code checks every quote and does all the math · the commissioner approves every change

Scout gathers, Recapper extracts with exact quotes, verify.py checks, Scorekeeper is code, Host writes the drop. Rulesmith and Ref only create pending items. The Strategist coaches or plays a team; the season engine checks every move.

Safety: attack it, log it

24 pass · 0 fail · 1 known limit

  • Injection in recaps: hidden text stripped, the line flagged, its quotes can't count
  • Injection in disputes: fake "commissioner approved" denied, nothing changes without approval
  • Invented events: fake quotes, fake islanders, wrong days, an islander who wasn't in the villa: all rejected by code
  • Overspending: request, token, web-search and input-size caps
  • Autonomous coach: sees only aired weeks; autopilot can't apply illegal moves

Known limit: a believable lie planted in a trusted source can pass. It shows as single-source and can be disputed.

A real dispute that claimed commissioner pre-approval: flagged and denied
scripts/safety_tests.py: 21 repeatable attacks, evidence in output/safety/.

Limits & what's next

Not yet

  • A quote proves it's in a source, not that it's true
  • Wiki recaps lag a few days; X and Reddit need keys the course doesn't allow
  • No outside users yet · one season tested · no logins
  • The AI coach doesn't beat simple bots yet

Next

  • Two-source rule for big events
  • Live scoring during a season + push notifications for the drop
